notes: 29 of 30 budgeted searches/fetches used. Stack Overflow returned 0; GitHub 'pulse debit' results (31) were all unrelated projects; Reddit search.json returned an HTML login wall for all four subreddits (0 items, not a true zero). No public PULSE developer portal, sandbox or forum surfaced, so developer/sandbox/certification/onboarding/support queries produced nothing partner-authored. Excluded: HN comment by bob1029 (2023-09-08, former Pulse employee on 60-second outage response; employee sentiment is out of scope); Capital One CEO Richard Fairbank quotes (network owner, not a partner); NRF and Merchants Payments Coalition opposed the Capital One-Discover merger but no verbatim quote was retrieved; Deutsche Bank analyst Mark DeVries estimate seen only in search-summary text, not verbatim; ATM Marketplace NAAIO surcharge article dated 2010 (out of window). Excerpts come from WebFetch extraction and should be spot-checked against the page before citing. Wayback archive lookups were not run for budget reasons; archive_url is null throughout. Almost all sentiment is about the Capital One migration of debit onto Discover Debit/PULSE and Durbin exemption rather than PULSE's operational service to partners. No ATM operator, issuer/credit union, fintech or program manager voice about PULSE was found in window.
